integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically and independently checked by finite exhaustive and matrix computations; these checks do not constitute independent external validation. No empirical data are represented as proof of the infinite-family statement.
scientific_limitations: Valid for \(K_{m,n}\) with one deleted cross-edge, \(m,n\ge2\), synchronous neighbor sums over finite fields of characteristic two. Does not cover other field characteristics, multiple edge defects, or asynchronous updates. Close work already obtains the same six-periodic module on other graph families. An unindexed equivalent historical classification cannot be excluded.
title: A missing biclique edge switches parity dynamics among extinction, two-cycles and six-cycles
